name: Shimohira Yuki
source: One of the characters of the Placebo storyline (appears exclusively in the remake's "YUKI" episode). A first year student at the Hinashiro High School. [spoiler]Has psychic abilities, which she uses to aid Morishima Tokio and his affiliate during their attempt at exorcising the ghost haunting the train platform.[/spoiler]
